Author: @kevinmo1
Content: Is it me or is this game not very good, I mean the very concept of a horror rage game sounds terrible already. A rage game's purpose is to keep setting the player's progression back to one spot while a horror game usually needs to progress to introduce more kinds of scares otherwise it becomes boring and repetitive(which this game seems to be). Not to mention the only real difficulty this game has is the sloppy controls and the tiny bit of randomization between runs, otherwise this game is just move in a straight line simulator and hope you get lucky one of the enemies don't hit you. Not to mention the jump scares are kinda lame looking and sounding and just overall annoying considering just how many time you have to see them over and over again in rapid succession. Good thing this is just a demo and hopefully the creator can make some changes because the game looks not even rage game unfun where you would still want to play, but just generally unfun and boring.
